entities.name: Extended emergency number list
entities.description: Contains a list of emergency numbers with URN information, valid within the same country as the PLMN or only in the PLMN from which it is received.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that may send the extended emergency number list information element.

entities.name: Emergency numbers
entities.description: List of emergency numbers with URN information provided in the extended emergency number list IE.

entities.name: PLMN validity
entities.description: Condition specifying that emergency numbers are valid within the same country as the PLMN or only in the PLMN from which the IE is received.

relations.description: Network may send the extended emergency number list IE.
Extended emergency number list IE contains emergency numbers with URN information.
Validity of emergency numbers is guarded by PLMN-specific conditions.
